medical-centre.description: The Grand Turk, 207 Sutton Road, Kidderminster The Grand Turk is a Marstons pub and one of the two pubs in Sutton Road. It is opposite to Kidderminster Hospital. It is named after the replica frigate "The Grand Turk" which was constructed in Turkey in 1996, primarily for TV and film work.
